in_english.name: Sulaym
in_english.meaning: peace, security, safe, secure, protected, tranquil
in_english.long_meaning: The name Sulaym originates from the Arabic root S-L-M, meaning peace, security, safe, secure, protected, and tranquil. In the Quran, Sulaym is mentioned in Surah Al-A'raf (7:176) as the story of Sulaym bin Meshkum, one of the companions of the Prophet Muhammad. Sulaym is considered a beautiful name for both males and females, symbolizing peace and security in life. It can also be used to refer to a righteous and merciful person.
